title: Repair agentSdkMcpClient typing for claude-agent-sdk 0.3.260
description: PR #528 (dependabot model-provider-sdks: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.251->0.3.260, @anthropic-ai/sdk ^0.122->^0.123) fails npm run typecheck on every platform: packages/core/src/model/agentSdkMcpClient.ts(208,3) TS2322 - SdkMcpToolDefinition<Readonly<{[k:string]: $ZodType<...>}>> is not assignable to SdkMcpToolDefinition<AnyZodRawShape>. The new SDK changed its zod raw-shape typing. Branch off the #528 head, repair the source, verify, and open a superseding PR.
notes: PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/534 open (supersedes #528, which is closed). Bead stays in_progress until #534 merges.
